claim: Versioned newest-exact verified memory plus explicit provenance/supersession handles clean and moderate-noise drift more accurately, cheaply and simply; CMX marginal coupons/rent add no independent benefit.
interpretation: At 15% noisy verification CMX slightly exceeds latest, but the defining coupon/rent ablations fail; therefore this is not evidence for the proposed mechanism. The high-noise crossover is better interpreted as a prompt for denoising/aggregation baselines.
